title: 第22章 举堂皆惊
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
一团巨大的白光，明亮到了极致。

    而后，在众目睽睽之下，光芒慢慢褪去。

    光晕一点点地缩小。

    桌子边角，缓缓显现出一道身影。

    众人定目看去。

    那原来缩成一团的【赴死蚁】...

    此刻，竟然变得非常壮硕！

    甲壳呈深黑色，泛着一层玄色乌光，比方才足足大了不止一圈！

    它以前，还是一只觉醒一级，身体又枯瘦又虚弱的残蚁。

    转瞬之间，在那块石头能量的注入下……

    直接将它的觉醒等级，一路提升到了四级！

    这么快速的提升，如此突然壮大起来的身躯...

    本身，就足以让人心头一凛！

    可偏偏。

    如此壮实的身子骨上，还顶着一条，缩成一团不敢着地的瘸腿...

    寂静。

    没人能想的明白。

    这只被【砺勇石】选中，全场天赋最高的蚁...

    怎么，就没有进化呢？

    前排。

    王健盯着那最后一排的角落，僵在了那里。

    他出了一百两。

    他那只蚁，无论是根骨、还是威势...

    本应是这满库里头的头一份。

    可那枚石头，偏偏越过了他，去寻了一只残蚁。

    “啪，啪，啪！”

    三声掌声，不急不慢地从讲台那边传了过来。

    金教习，一边击着掌，一边踱步了过来。

    那双往常满是严厉的眸里，此刻竟流露出毫不掩饰的赞叹。

    “一条残废了的蚁……”

    在寂静的学堂中，他的声音，格外清晰：

    “竟然，压过了满堂这五百只蚁。”

    “成为了，天赋最高的那一只...”

    他走到了罗影的课桌前，停下了脚步。

    “你……”

    他第一次，把目光从蚂蚁转到了罗影身上。

    也是他头一回，这么仔仔细细的打量一个人。

    少年身穿洗得发白的粗布短打，裤脚还有没有擦干净的泥。

    穿成这样，显然是一个只交得起六两束脩的底层孩子。

    这个世道，银子开道。
content_en:
A huge white light, extremely bright.

Then, in full view of everyone, the light slowly faded.

The halo shrinks little by little.

A figure slowly appeared at the corner of the table.

Everyone looked intently.

The [ants going to die] that were huddled together...

At this moment, he has become very strong!

The carapace was dark black with a layer of black light, and it was more than a circle bigger than before!

Before, it was a remnant ant that had awakened to the first level and was skinny and weak.

In the blink of an eye, under the injection of energy from that stone...

Directly raising its awakening level all the way to level four!

Such a rapid improvement, such a sudden growth of body...

In itself, it’s enough to make people’s hearts tremble!

Can be biased.

Such a strong body is supported by a lame leg that curls up into a ball and dare not touch the ground...

Silence.

No one can figure it out.

This ant was selected by [Riyongshi] and has the highest talent in the game...

Why, there is no evolution?

Front row.

Wang Jian stared at the corner of the last row and froze there.

He paid a hundred taels.

That ant of his, whether it's his bones or his power...

It was supposed to be the first item in this full library.

But the stone happened to pass him and went to find a remnant ant.

"Pah, pah, pah!"

Three rounds of applause came from the podium in a leisurely manner.

Jin Jiaoxi paced over while high-fiving.

Those eyes that were usually full of sternness now revealed unabashed admiration.

"A crippled ant..."

In the silent school, his voice was particularly clear:

"Unexpectedly, it overwhelmed the five hundred ants in the hall."

"It has become the one with the highest talent..."

He walked to Luo Ying's desk and stopped.

"You..."

For the first time, he turned his attention from the ants to Luo Ying.

It was also the first time that he looked at someone so carefully.

The boy was wearing a pair of coarse cloth that had turned white after washing, and the legs of his trousers were still stained with mud.

Dressed like this, he is obviously a low-class kid who can only afford six or two bouquets of repairs.

In this world, money clears the way.
